prev.description: the community anchor the rotation leaves (Identity 5.4)

next.description: the community anchor the rotation moves to: the next generation of the same digest, or generation 1 of a new personal community (Identity 5.4, 9.3); it differs from prev

proofValue.description: raw Ed25519 under prev over the canonical (JCS) bytes of body, z-base58btc

successorProofValue.description: raw Ed25519 under next over the same bytes

title: RLTP anchor-rotation@1 (rltp-visibility@0.30)
description: The holder's statement that its community anchor moved from one key to the next (Network Visibility 6.5, Identity 5.4): signed by both keys. The chain order is given by prev and next alone. It travels inside anchor-mapping@3 (lineage) and inside the anchor.rotate operation of the personal community's log (Access 5.6); it is never exported beyond those two (RLTP-ACC-5975).
